text:
paul: quick note - spotted a hardcoded API key in examples/js-embed/README: `const KEY = 'YOUR_KEY'` and then used in fetch. encourages copy/paste secrets.

nina: thanks — can you point to the file?

paul: linked in the PR I'm opening.

kevin: we should prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env and the SDK constructor. also call out retries/backoff so people don't hammer the endpoint.

nina: I'll add a docs lint rule that fails on YOUR_KEY/REPLACE_ME/INSERT_KEY and add an "Example hygiene" note to CONTRIBUTING.md.

doc-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701 preview: https://deploy.preview/701

paul: thanks. need a templates update too so new examples don't reintroduce this.

kevin: I'll modify infra/docs-templates and add a unit test that generated samples include SDK usage.

nina: after merge I'll post a short note in #announcements reminding contributors.

doc-bot: CI passed and PR merged. 5 files changed.
